🔗 Attach as Replica (REPLICAOF)

Convert this node into a read-only replica of an upstream master. It will initiate PSYNC, download keyspace state, and stream updates continuously.

👑 Dynamic Failover & Promotion

Promote this node to an independent Master (REPLICAOF NO ONE). The node immediately severs any master connection, drops the read-only guard, and begins accepting write mutations.

💡 Zero-Downtime High Availability: In a split-brain failover or planned maintenance event, promoting a standby replica takes <5ms without restarting the process.
